snippet.title: Funguys Swarm — Official Announcement Trailer | 4K
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3449620/Funguys_Swarm_Demo/

COMING TO STEAM AND EPIC GAME STORE 2025 🍄🔥
WISHLIST NOW!
Steam: http://swg.gg/ytpfgsstm
Epic Game Store: http://swg.gg/epicfgs

Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire—and it’s very much not fine. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe—just maybe—save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

Subscribe to the channel and follow us on our socials for the latest Funguys update ⬇️
Discord: https://discord.gg/stairway
X/Twitter: https://twitter.com/funguys_swarm
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/funguys.swarm
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/funguys_swarm
